title: In Opex week, every session tightens — except London

hero.caption: that's how much **Asia**'s range shrinks in Opex week (NY tightens too, −6%). But **London barely moves** — the only session that keeps its normal range.

chart.label: Range in Opex week vs the rest of the month
chart.sub: Below the dotted line = tighter range than a normal week
chart.note: Every session tightens in Opex week — except London, which trades its normal range.

useIt: If you trade Opex week, London is where the range survives. Asia goes quiet and NY is a touch tighter — don't expect big overnight moves outside the London session.
